key_insight: A deep learning model matched colon capsule images of the same polyp with reported accuracy up to 92% and AUC near 0.98.
clinical_relevance: Automated polyp matching could reduce duplicate counting and unnecessary follow-up searches, but clinical benefit remains to be established.
method: Siamese neural network trained with contrastive learning.
Compared ResNet, DenseNet121, and EfficientNet backbones.
Used cosine distance to distinguish same-polyp from different-polyp image pairs.
evidence_signal: The study used 5,103 same-polyp and 5,103 different-polyp image pairs from the Danish CareForColon2015 trial, annotated by experienced clinicians.
watch_item: The abstract does not report external validation or whether evaluation splits prevented patient-level data leakage.
